All — reviewed the MAP and added a canary-runbook checklist (high level bullets below, full PDF attached as canary-runbook.pdf):
- Pre-canary smoke tests (model load, kv-cache warmup, auth flows)
- Canary traffic steps: 5% (24h) -> 20% (48h) -> 50% (72h) -> 100%
- Acceptance gates at each step: 95th latency < 350ms, error rate < 0.5%, no >5% degradation in quality score on sentinel prompts
- Automatic rollback on gate failure + manual ops review
- Canary monitoring: dedicated Grafana dashboard + token-level cost tracking

Alex/Team — quick notes on evaluation criteria I added to the MAP:
- Canary quantitative metrics (per 24h):
  - 95th percentile latency target: <= 350ms for typical prompt set (we’ll validate with your sample prompts)
  - Error rate (5xx / failed requests): < 0.5%
  - Quality sentinel pass-rate: >= 92% on predefined evaluation prompts (we will run daily slice checks)
  - Token cost delta: track cost per 10k tokens vs baseline; rollback if >20% higher than expected within the first 72h
- Qualitative checks: daily sample reviews with Prospero SMEs (clinical content owners) at 10:00 PT

On rollback latency: pulling a variant and switching to a fallback (same model family, different quantization) is typically sub-5min for routing changes; cold-start KV cache can add 3–10 minutes for warmup depending on prefix cache hit rates. We’ll include a cache-warming step in the runbook to minimize impact.

I also added a simple automated smoke script that will run after each traffic step to validate semantic sanity on 20 sentinel prompts.

Jonas
Senior Infra Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
